finding: The existing authenticated evidence manifest validates whole-output hashes but does not bind those hashes to independently verified per-page transport receipts. A manifest could therefore pass whole-output checks without proving the retained bytes came from the documented successful, version-selected, request-identified Link-header page chain.
design_implication: Require two independently digested transport receipts to match the exact commit, page count, record count, and raw-output SHA-256 values of the primary and independent enumeration methods before authenticated evidence promotion.
uncertainty: No authenticated private-repository page capture was performed in this run.
The binding verifies transport provenance relationships, not provider completeness above documented search ceilings.
The current Vercel manifest writer has not yet imported this validator.
falsification_route: Construct a manifest whose enumeration raw_output_sha256 differs from its transport receipt, whose selected API version differs from the requested version, whose final page retains a next URL, or whose two receipt digests are identical; the validator must reject it.
